title: Integrity Assertion
description: Operator attestations that the answer-integrity boundary held for this turn. All four members are REQUIRED and constrained to `true`; a turn that cannot assert them is not billable.
$comment:
Defined by SPEC.md §7 (invariant I2).

There is deliberately no conformant encoding for a violated boundary. Admitting decode influence is a settlement-level breach, not a field value.

Commercial basis: survey evidence indicates roughly two thirds of US adults report lower trust in AI answers when ads are present (Ipsos). In retail media, the nearest structural analogue, 30-40% of sponsored-product sales are estimated to cannibalize purchases that would have occurred organically. A surface that bends its answers converges on display CPMs. See docs/documentation/market-context.md §3.

organic_answer_digest.description: Digest of the exact bytes shown to the user as the answer, excluding the ad block and its separator.
organic_answer_digest.$comment: The commitment that makes 'the ad did not change the answer' checkable. A settlement-time audit MAY re-request it.

no_decode_influence.description: Asserts that no bid value, advertiser identity, or campaign state was an input to generation.
no_decode_influence.$comment: Covers sampling, logit biasing, beam scoring, speculative decoding, model routing, system-prompt selection, generation conditioned on the winning ad, and re-ranking of candidate answers by expected revenue. At trust tier 2 this is covered by the binary attestation.

ad_excluded_from_context.description: Asserts that creative content did not enter the model's context for this turn and will be stripped before any subsequent summarization or re-feed.
ad_excluded_from_context.$comment: An ad slot is an attacker-controlled text channel adjacent to a model. A system that interpolates purchased text into a prompt has granted write access to its own reasoning. See SPEC.md §7.2.

disclosure_rendered.description: Asserts that the disclosure was rendered in-band before or at the moment the user could act on the placement.
disclosure_rendered.$comment: Not defeated by contrast, size, collapse, timing, or scroll position. A billable precondition: an unrendered disclosure makes the impression non-billable, not merely non-compliant.

composer.description: Identifies the function that joined answer and creative.
composer.$comment: The composer concatenates and MUST NOT rewrite. It MUST NOT be a language model. See SPEC.md §7.1.
